customer_message.subject: Termination of my lease, Allmendstrasse 120, Muttenz
customer_message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Stiftung Wohnen Zentral's termination letter reached me a week ago: they are ending the lease of my 3-room flat at Allmendstrasse 120 in Muttenz with effect from 30 April 2027.

The stated reason is rent arrears. I owe CHF 4320, two months' rent, because my unemployment benefit was delayed.

I believe the arrears are only a pretext. In August I wrote to the Stiftung, with a copy to the conciliation authority, demanding that they repair the leaking windows and reduce my rent until then. Two weeks later the termination came. I am convinced they want to punish me for standing up for my rights.

If I cannot stay, I will need more time. My son has Type 1 diabetes and is in treatment at the children's hospital in Basel; moving away in the middle of his school year and his therapy would be very hard, and there are almost no affordable flats nearby. I want to ask for an extension of the tenancy.

What should I do, and by when?

Yours sincerely,
Hannah Brennan
